base_member_text: [L21] (MED/autoconf/syntax) The AC_SUBST call has an unusual unmatched-looking quote/bracket sequence (`['$(top_srcdir)/makedepo.py])'`), leaving the generated MAKEDEPO value and macro parsing contract unclear.
audit_member_text: [L21] (HIGH/configure-syntax) A stray single quote follows AC_SUBST and is emitted into configure shell code, corrupting shell quoting and preventing reliable configuration.

adversarial.rationale: The quote inside the AC_SUBST value opens the shell string, and the quote after the macro invocation closes it: expansion using the installed Autoconf macro emitted MAKEDEPO= followed by a single-quoted $(top_srcdir)/makedepo.py and a trailing newline, and that assignment passed sh -n and executed successfully. Thus the claimed unmatched-quote/configure-syntax failure is false; the embedded newline is a separate value issue rather than broken shell quoting.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

audit_member_text: [L43-L53] (MED/dependency-detection-contract) MPI mode and FC replacement depend on the requested option rather than an explicitly checked successful ACX_MPI result, leaving failed MPI discovery without a local failure guard.
[L73-L76] (MED/dependency-validation) The NetCDF fallback accepts netcdf >= 4 package metadata without checking that its Fortran module and library are present and usable by the selected compiler.
